description: A static map's keyword keys can be analyzed as types
notes: The native syntax spec interprets a bare identifier object key as a literal attribute name as opposed to a variable reference, and the README leaves what a keyword is to the syntax, while the static map section returns keys with no further interpretation (native/analysis/map-key-identifier-as-traversal). hashicorp/hcl keeps a bare key as a ScopeTraversalExpr inside an ObjectConsKeyExpr, whose AsTraversal gives the wrapped expression's traversal (hclsyntax/expression.go), so hcl.ExprAsKeyword gives string and number and getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) reads them as types.
